name: nizam-skill-index-negative-fixture-unindexed
description: Negative fixture for validator check C13 (phase-014 feature 106, NDEBT-044 a). Every capabilities[].module resolves to an existing file. The planning entry is the authoritative_source of a NIZAM.json capability, so it is not the failure. The unindexed-capability entry points at ecosystem/README.md, which is absent from the NIZAM.json capability index. Substituting this file for tools/skill.json must make the full sweep print [C13] FAIL because that module is unindexed, not because a pointer dangles. The filename carries the canonical _neg_ token and no C12 family prefix, so C12 ignores it.

capabilities.name: planning
capabilities.description: Indexed control. methodology/00_planning.md is a NIZAM.json authoritative_source.

capabilities.name: unindexed-capability
capabilities.description: Resolves on disk, but ecosystem/README.md is not a NIZAM.json capability authoritative_source.

file_read_write.description: The host environment must be able to read and write files in the consumer repository, including a durable-state directory (conventionally .agent/).

shell_execution.description: The host environment must be able to run verification commands (tests, checks, schema validation) and capture their exit codes and output.

structured_data_parsing.description: The host environment must be able to parse and emit JSON, and parse YAML frontmatter blocks and YAML phase/template documents.

live_runtime_session.description: Optional live-runtime-session adapter capability. Only claiming adapters implement the seven calls and conditional S1-S9 checks; existing adapters remain conformant.

root_index.description: The compact root capability index and context router an agent queries first (DD-1) to locate the minimal set of governance files a task requires.
